No. Files you add to a tool are processed in your browser and are not uploaded to ToolsKit. The PDF and QR tools use open-source libraries that are served from ToolsKit’s own site, not from a third-party CDN.
Students, professionals, creators, small businesses and everyday users who need a quick browser-based utility for a PDF, image, QR code, conversion, calculation or CV.
Which PDF tasks are not available?

ToolsKit can merge, split, rotate and compress PDFs and convert between PDFs and images. It does not currently convert PDFs to Word or Excel, edit PDF text, sign, unlock or password-protect PDFs, or run OCR.

English, plus a growing selection of tools in German, French, Italian, Spanish, Dutch and Polish. Each language lists only the tools that have been translated into it; use the language list in the header or footer to switch.
Can I rely on the calculators?
They give estimates from the numbers you enter. The VAT calculator does not look up your country’s rate, and none of the calculators replace financial or tax advice.

about_title: About ToolsKit — Free Online Everyday Tools
about_desc: ToolsKit is a collection of free online tools that run in your browser: PDF, image, QR code, converters, calculators, CV and social media tools.
privacy_desc: How ToolsKit handles your files, inputs and data: browser-based processing, local storage, third-party code, analytics, logs and your rights.
terms_desc: The terms for using ToolsKit’s free online tools: acceptable use, limitations, no warranty, calculator disclaimers and liability.
llms_summary: ToolsKit is a collection of free online tools that run in the browser: PDF tools, image tools, QR code generators, unit converters, calculators, a CV and resume builder and template-based social media text generators. No account is required. Files and inputs are processed in the browser and are not uploaded to ToolsKit.
llms_about: what ToolsKit is, who it is for, how tools run and their limits
llms_privacy: Tools run in the visitor's browser. Files and typed inputs are not sent to a ToolsKit server.
The PDF and QR tools use open-source libraries (pdf-lib, PDF.js, JSZip, qrcodejs) that are served from ToolsKit's own site, not a third-party CDN.

ToolsKit stores only a list of recently opened tool names (and a CV draft if the visitor chooses Save draft) in the visitor's own browser. It sets no cookies and currently uses no analytics or advertising.
llms_audience: Students, professionals, creators, small businesses and everyday users who need a quick browser-based utility.
llms_not: No PDF to Word/Excel conversion, PDF text editing, signing, password removal or OCR.
Calculators give estimates only; the VAT calculator uses the rate the visitor enters and does not look up country rates. Nothing is tax or financial advice.
Social media generators use fixed templates, not AI.
